high_level_description: The image depicts a person standing on a staircase with a brick wall in the background. The individual is wearing a black outfit consisting of a short-sleeved top and high-waisted pants, secured with a black belt that has a silver buckle. The person's hair is long and dark, styled in loose waves. They have one hand resting on the railing of the staircase and the other hand placed in their pocket. The setting appears to be an urban environment, possibly within a building or a public space. The staircase has black railings with metal cables running horizontally along them.
